annotations.title: Find a place in a hospital

description: Find where a ward, clinic, department, entrance or facility (pharmacy, café, toilets, reception) is inside a UK hospital that Findway has mapped. Returns where it is (building and floor, as the hospital's map records it) and a link that opens step-by-step walking directions from the entrance. For questions like 'where is Kangaroo Ward at Great Ormond Street?'.

hospital.description: The hospital's name, e.g. 'Great Ormond Street Hospital' or 'St George's Hospital, Tooting'. A town helps when names are shared.

place.description: The ward, clinic, department or facility, e.g. 'Kangaroo Ward', 'ENT', 'X-ray', 'pharmacy', 'main entrance'.

name: find_place
title: Find a place in a hospital
